article_butterflies.summary: Butterflies do not arrive in the world as butterflies. They start as eggs and change their whole shape. After reading this, you can name the four stages of a butterfly, tell a caterpillar from a chrysalis, and help a butterfly grow in your garden without hurting it.
article_butterflies.title: How Butterflies Grow and Change

article_how_planes_fly.summary: An airplane is heavy, and yet it flies. After reading this, you can explain why the wings hold a plane up, name the parts of an airplane, and tell what happens between the airport gate and the sky.
article_how_planes_fly.title: How Do Airplanes Fly?

article_talking_about_the_weather.summary: The weather is the easiest subject in the world to talk about, because everybody has one. After reading this you can describe the sky, tell how hot or cold it is, say what the weather is like, and choose the right clothes for the day.
article_talking_about_the_weather.title: Talking About the Weather
